A0189.title: Virtual Asset Cross-Chain Verification
A0189.description: Use cross-chain bridges, atomic swaps, hash time locks, and light node verification to ensure the authenticity and atomicity of virtual asset cross-chain transfers, preventing attackers from constructing asymmetric transactions between the source chain and the target chain to perform double-spending or mint assets out of thin air.
A0189.definition: Use cross-chain bridges and atomic swaps to ensure security of virtual asset transfers.
A0189.limitation: If the centralized or multi-signature verification nodes of a cross-chain bridge are compromised, cross-chain verification credentials can be forged to steal locked assets; light node verification relies on the finality of the source chain, and reorganization attacks or long-range reorganizations can roll back verified transactions leading to double-spending; leakage of the hash time lock preimage or timeout design flaws can be exploited by attackers to construct non-atomic swap arbitrage; tampering with the cross-chain message relay layer can forge cross-chain events causing the target chain to mistakenly mint assets, rendering the verification mechanism ineffective.
